title: Employee Handbook - Synthetic Interview Demo
content: VACATION POLICY: Full-time employees receive 20 paid vacation days per calendar year. Vacation requests must be submitted to the employee's manager at least 10 business days before the start date. Up to 5 unused vacation days may be carried into the next calendar year and must be used by March 31. REMOTE WORK POLICY: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. SECURITY POLICY: Employees must use multi-factor authentication for corporate applications. This handbook is synthetic interview demonstration data.
